observations: Two photos show a wooden pallet lying on a dirt ground.
The pallet has a standard 4-way design with horizontal slats and vertical support beams.
The wood appears light-colored, possibly pine or softwood, with visible grain and some minor surface wear.
There is a small knot visible on the top right side of the pallet in photo 1.
The pallet is not stained or painted, showing natural wood color.
No brand, model, or size markings are visible on the pallet itself.
The seller claims it is a 1.2 x 0.8 x 0.144m pallet, but no measurement is shown in the photos.

claims.claim: EURO/EPAL wooden pallet 1.2 x 0.8 x 0.144 in size
claims.evidence: The size is not visible in the photos. The seller's text claims it, but no measurement or label confirms it.

claims.claim: Food grade, used only once for clean water. No crack, no leak, lids complete.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The pallet may not be food-grade or suitable for food handling, as no certification or label is visible.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of any certification label or food-grade marking on the pallet.
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-food-grade, which reduces value significantly.

risks.risk: The pallet may be damaged or structurally compromised, such as broken slats or loose joints, which are not visible in the photos.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the underside and joints of the pallet, showing all slats and beams.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially damaged, which reduces value.

risks.risk: The size claim (1.2 x 0.8 x 0.144m) may be false or misleading.
risks.proof: A photo showing a measuring tape or ruler placed alongside the pallet to confirm dimensions.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown size, which reduces value.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of any size or model label on the pallet.
Close-up photo of the underside and joints of the pallet to check for damage.
Photo showing a measuring tape or ruler alongside the pallet to confirm dimensions.
Close-up photo of any certification or food-grade marking on the pallet.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
